sql_calls.sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM store.daily_sales
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS daily_sales_units,
  (SELECT SUM(revenue_inr) FROM store.daily_sales
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS daily_sales_revenue,
  (SELECT SUM(qty) FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS pos_units,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS audit_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') FROM store.shelf_audits
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS on_shelf_audits,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'empty') FROM store.shelf_audits
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS empty_audits;

SELECT audit_ts, sku, status
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-05-01'
  AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-02'
ORDER BY audit_ts;

SELECT d.date, d.units_sold, d.revenue_inr, i.book_on_hand_close,
       f.forecast_units_per_day, f.sigma, f.book_on_hand, f.ordered_units
FROM store.daily_sales d
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book i ON i.date = d.date AND i.sku = d.sku
LEFT JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.date = d.date AND f.sku = d.sku
WHERE d.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND d.date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND d.date < DATE '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY d.date;

SELECT 'stock_counts' AS source, count_ts::text AS ts, sku, book_before::text AS a, counted::text AS b, adjustment::text AS c, trigger AS d
FROM store.stock_counts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'write_offs', date::text, sku, units::text, reason, NULL, NULL
FROM store.write_offs
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY ts;

sql_calls.sql:
SELECT sku,
       COUNT(*) AS audits,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'empty') AS empty,
       MIN(audit_ts) AS first_audit,
       MAX(audit_ts) AS last_audit
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY sku
ORDER BY sku;

SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(units_sold), 0) FROM store.daily_sales
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS june_units_daily_sales,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS june_units_pos,
  (SELECT MIN(date) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS first_sales_row,
  (SELECT MAX(date) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS last_sales_row,
  COUNT(*) AS june_audits,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf_audits,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'empty') AS empty_audits,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'on shelf') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS on_shelf_availability_pct
FROM store.shelf_audits a
WHERE a.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND a.audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
  AND a.audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01';

SELECT SUM(units_sold) AS bags_sold
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  AND date < DATE '2026-07-01';

SELECT
  MIN(date) AS min_date,
  MAX(date) AS max_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS distinct_dates,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE date >= DATE '2026-06-29') AS rows_on_jun_29_30,
  COUNT(DISTINCT date) FILTER (WHERE date >= DATE '2026-06-29') AS dates_on_jun_29_30
FROM store.daily_sales;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS audits,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf_audits,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'empty') AS empty_audits,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') / COUNT(*), 2) AS on_shelf_availability_pct
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
  AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01';

SELECT
  MIN(bill_ts) AS first_atta_bill_ts,
  MAX(bill_ts) AS last_atta_bill_ts,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-29' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS atta_lines_jun_29_30,
  COALESCE(SUM(qty) FILTER (WHERE bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-29' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'), 0) AS atta_units_jun_29_30
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
  AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01';

SELECT
  (SELECT MIN(ts) FROM payments.pos_payments) AS first_payment_ts,
  (SELECT MAX(ts) FROM payments.pos_payments) AS last_payment_ts,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) FROM payments.pos_payments WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-29' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS bills_jun_29_30,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.pos_lines WHERE bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-29' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS tracked_lines_jun_29_30,
  (SELECT MAX(bill_ts) FROM store.pos_lines) AS last_tracked_line_ts;
